verdict.rationale: Spline's docs describe reusable Components whose instances stay linked to the main component and update when it changes, which covers the reuse and linked-to-source part of the story. Nothing in the evidence documents variants or per-instance overrides. missing for 10: component variants, per-instance overrides that keep the link, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source

citations.quote: Components are objects that can be reused multiple times throughout your scene and whenever there are changes made to the main component all instances will update accordingly.
